forum.title: VL53L8CX Programmable FOV
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi:

VL53L8CX can’t support to program FOV. We only have a few that can be supported, such as VL53L1CX/CB. The API interfaces are as follows for your reference

[A guide to using the VL53L1X ultra lite driver - User manual](https://www.st.com/resource/en/user_manual/um2510-a-guide-to-using-the-vl53l1x-ultra-lite-driver-stmicroelectronics.pdf)

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/6f41cc86-5643-4567-a7f4-faba3a70cfea.png)

Best regards,

Bin FAN
forum.content_text:
Hi, I am evaluating VL53L8CX and couldn’t find anything in the data sheet about a programmable FOV. I require a FOV of 2-3degrees. Does this sensor support a programmable FOV to that size?

Thanks,
